interface_name.description: Network interface on which to advertise router advertisements (e.g., 'eth0', 'wlan0').

send_advertisements.description: Enable or disable sending of router advertisements on this interface.

min_interval.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between unsolicited router advertisements.

max_interval.description: Maximum time (in seconds) between router advertisements. If omitted, defaults to min_interval.

hop_limit.description: Default hop limit for packets (typically 64 or 255).

prefixes.description: List of IPv6 prefixes to advertise on this interface.

route_descriptors.description: List of route information (RFC 4191) to advertise.

rdnss_list.description: List of recursive DNS servers (RDNSS) to advertise.

dnssl_list.description: List of DNS search domains (DNSSL) to advertise.
